fullPassage: One word is inextricably associated with geography: where. That is because geography starts from the premise that it matters where something takes place on Earth's surface. The key questions are not simply "where" questions, though; they are "why there" and "so what" questions. Getting to such questions means taking spatial arrangements, variations, and interconnections seriously. Engaging in even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some appreciation of spatial circumstances — where to find food and services, how to get to work places, and the like. Moving up in scale, without some awareness of the significance of spatial relationships, it is difficult to make reasoned business or policy judgments, make sense of events, or grasp some of the basic forces shaping life on the planet. Locating a new store or public service requires taking into consideration population distributions, the location of roads and utilities, socio-economic patterns, and more. Understanding why and where migration happens requires consideration of the political organization of territory, the spatial consequences of discrimination, socio-economic patterns, and the layout of the physical environment.

✅ ② 글 전체가 공간적 인식의 중요성 강조
❌ ① 역사적 사건: 언급 없음
❌ ③ 기후 변화: 언급 없음
❌ ④ 경제적 요인만: too narrow
det.tip: 주제 = spatial relationships의 significance

questions.passage: One word is inextricably associated with geography: where. That is because geography starts from the premise that it matters where something takes place on Earth's surface. The key questions are not simply "where" questions; they are "why there" and "so what" questions. Locating a new store or public service requires taking into consideration population distributions, the location of roads and utilities, socio-economic patterns, and more. Understanding why and where migration happens requires consideration of the political organization of territory, the spatial consequences of discrimination, socio-economic patterns, and the layout of the physical environment.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 이주 문제는 정치적 요인만으로 설명할 수 있다.
새로운 사업 입지는 인구 분포만이 결정한다.
지리학은 공간적 맥락이 왜 중요한지를 탐구하며, 이는 사업 판단부터 이주 이해까지 영향을 미친다.

det.korean: 요지: 지리학은 공간적 맥락의 중요성을 탐구하며, 사업~이주까지 광범위하게 영향.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ 글 전체 요약
❌ ① 자연환경만: too narrow
❌ ② 정치적 요인만: too narrow
❌ ③ 인구 분포만: too narrow
det.tip: 요지 = 공간적 관계가 다양한 영역에 미치는 광범위한 영향

questions.passage: One word is inextricably associated with geography: where. That is because geography starts from the premise that it matters where something takes place on Earth's surface. The key questions are not simply "where" questions, though; they are "why there" and "so what" questions. Getting to such questions means taking spatial arrangements, variations, and interconnections seriously. Engaging in even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some appreciation of spatial circumstances — where to find food and services, how to get to work places, and the like. Moving up in scale, without some awareness of the significance of spatial relationships, it is difficult to make reasoned business or policy judgments, make sense of events, or grasp some of the basic forces shaping life on the planet. Locating a new store or public service requires taking into consideration population distributions, the location of roads and utilities, socio-economic patterns, and more. Understanding why and where migration happens requires consideration of the political organization of territory, the spatial consequences of discrimination, socio-economic patterns, and the layout of the physical environment.
questions.stem:
다음 한국어를 영어로 완성하시오.
"가장 단순한 일상 활동에도 공간적 상황에 대한 약간의 이해가 필요하다."
Even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some __________ of spatial circumstances.

det.korean: Even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some appreciation of spatial circumstances.
det.analysis: some + 명사 구조 → appreciation(이해, 인식)
det.tip: appreciation = 이해, 인식, 감사
